quests.instruction: Which of these is a flat shape, not a solid shape?
quests.hint: Think about which one you could not pick up and hold as a block.
quests.explanation: A drawing on paper is flat, with only length and width. A box and a can are solid, so they also have height.
quests.funFact: Flat shapes are also called 2D shapes because they have two measurements: length and width.

quests.instruction: A circle and a sphere both look round. What is the difference between them?
quests.correctAnswer: A sphere is a solid you can hold, and a circle is flat
options: A sphere is flat, and a circle is a solid you can hold
A sphere is a solid you can hold, and a circle is flat
There is no difference, because both are round
quests.hint: Think about a drawing of a ball compared with a real ball.
quests.explanation: A circle is a flat shape drawn on a surface. A sphere is a solid shape, like a ball, with height as well as length and width.
quests.funFact: The word sphere comes from a Greek word for ball.

quests.instruction: A solid shape takes up space. Which of these takes up space?
options: A drawing of a block on paper
A shadow of a block on a wall
quests.hint: Which one could you pick up?
quests.explanation: A real block is a solid, so it takes up space. A drawing and a shadow are flat and take up no space of their own.
quests.funFact: The amount of space a solid takes up is called its volume.

quests.instruction: Which everyday object is shaped like a sphere?
quests.hint: Look for the object that is round in every direction.
quests.explanation: A basketball is round all the way around, like a sphere. A drinking glass is like a cylinder and a book is like a cuboid.
quests.funFact: Planets and stars are nearly spheres because gravity pulls their material equally toward the center.

quests.instruction: Which object would roll in every direction if you pushed it?
options: A can lying on its side
quests.hint: A shape that rolls in every direction has no flat faces and no edges.
quests.explanation: A marble is a sphere, which is smooth and round everywhere, so it rolls in every direction. A can on its side rolls only one way, and a shoebox does not roll.
quests.funFact: Marbles have been used as toys for thousands of years.

quests.instruction: Why does a ball look like a circle from every side?
quests.correctAnswer: Every flat view of a sphere is a circle
options: A ball is really just a flat circle in disguise
Every flat view of a sphere is a circle
A ball has a flat circular face on each side
quests.hint: Walk around a ball in your mind. Does its outline ever change?
quests.explanation: A sphere is the same distance across in every direction, so its outline is always a circle. A ball is a solid, not a flat circle, and it has no flat face.
quests.funFact: A sphere is the only solid shape that looks like a circle from every direction.

quests.instruction: Which object is shaped like a cube?
quests.hint: A cube has the same size in every direction, like a small square box.
quests.explanation: A dice is shaped like a cube, with square faces that are all the same size. A pencil is long and thin, and a soup can is round.
quests.funFact: Dice have been used in games for thousands of years.

quests.instruction: A shoebox has rectangular faces and is longer than it is tall. What solid shape is it most like?
quests.hint: Compare the faces of the box with the faces of a dice.
quests.explanation: A box with rectangular faces is a cuboid. A cube needs every face to be a square of the same size, and a cylinder has round ends.
quests.funFact: A cuboid is also called a rectangular prism.

quests.instruction: What is the difference between a cube and a cuboid?
quests.correctAnswer: A cube has all square faces, and a cuboid has rectangular faces
options: A cube has curved faces, and a cuboid has flat faces
A cube has all square faces, and a cuboid has rectangular faces
A cube has more faces than a cuboid does
quests.hint: Think about the shape of the faces on a dice and on a cereal box.
quests.explanation: Every face of a cube is a square of the same size. A cuboid has rectangular faces, so it can be long, wide, or tall.
quests.funFact: A cube is a special cuboid in which every face is a square.

quests.instruction: Which object is shaped like a cylinder?
quests.hint: A cylinder has two flat round ends and a curved side.
quests.explanation: A soup can has two flat round ends joined by a curved side, so it is a cylinder. A party hat is a cone and a tennis ball is a sphere.
quests.funFact: Grain silos on farms are often cylinders.

quests.instruction: Which solid can roll in a straight line on its side and also stand on a flat end?
quests.hint: Think about a can: it can roll and it can sit upright.
quests.explanation: A cylinder has a curved side that lets it roll and flat round ends that let it stand. A sphere rolls but cannot stand, and a cube stands but does not roll.
quests.funFact: A rolling pin is a cylinder.

quests.instruction: A cylinder is cut straight across, parallel to its ends. What shape is the cut surface?
quests.hint: Picture slicing a cucumber into rounds.
quests.explanation: A cylinder has round ends, and a cut parallel to them gives the same round shape, so the cut surface is a circle.
quests.funFact: Slices of a cucumber are circles because a cucumber is close to a cylinder.

quests.instruction: Which solid has one pointed tip and a round flat base?
quests.hint: Think about the shape of the base and the shape of the tip.
quests.explanation: A cone has a round flat base and narrows to one pointed tip. A pyramid has a base made of straight sides, and a cylinder has no pointed tip.
quests.funFact: A cone has just one pointed tip.

quests.instruction: A party hat is shaped like a cone. What flat shape is the bottom edge of the hat?
quests.hint: Think about the opening that sits on your head.
quests.explanation: The bottom of a cone is a flat round face, so the bottom edge of the hat is a circle.
quests.funFact: Cutting a cone straight across, parallel to its base, always gives a circle.

quests.instruction: A cone is seen from the side. Which flat shape does it look like?
quests.hint: Picture the outline of an ice cream cone when it stands upright.
quests.explanation: From the side, a cone narrows from a wide base to a point at the top, so its outline is a triangle. From above, it would look like a circle.
quests.funFact: A cone can be made by rolling up a flat piece of paper shaped like part of a circle.

quests.instruction: The pyramids of Egypt have a square base and four triangle-shaped sides that meet at a point. What solid shape is this?
quests.hint: Think about the shape of the sides and the pointed top.
quests.explanation: A solid with a flat base and triangular sides that meet at one point is a pyramid. A cone has a round base, and a cube has no pointed top.
quests.funFact: The Great Pyramid of Giza was the tallest human-made structure in the world for about 3,800 years.

quests.instruction: Each sloping side of a square pyramid is shaped like which flat shape?
quests.hint: The sloping sides meet at a point at the top.
quests.explanation: The sloping sides of a square pyramid come together at the top, and a flat shape that narrows to a point is a triangle.
quests.funFact: A square pyramid has four triangular faces and one square face.

quests.instruction: Which solid has a pointed top and a flat base but is not round?
quests.hint: Cones are round all the way around. What pointed solid is not?
quests.explanation: A pyramid has flat faces and straight edges, so it is not round. A cone also has a point, but it has a curved side, and a sphere has no point at all.
quests.funFact: A pyramid can have any flat shape as its base, such as a triangle or a hexagon.

quests.instruction: Which solid can roll in any direction?
quests.hint: Think about which solid has no flat faces at all.
quests.explanation: A sphere is smooth and round everywhere, so it rolls in every direction. A cylinder rolls only in one direction, and a cube does not roll.
quests.funFact: The wheel is based on the circle, but a sphere can roll in every direction.

quests.instruction: Which solid is best for stacking into a neat, tall tower?
quests.hint: Look for a solid with flat faces on the top and the bottom.
quests.explanation: A cube has flat faces that sit on top of each other without sliding. A sphere rolls away and a cone has a pointed tip that is hard to stack on.
quests.funFact: Builders stack bricks in offset rows because flat faces make steady walls.

quests.instruction: A ball, a can, and a box are on a ramp. Which of them can roll down?
quests.hint: Look for the objects with a curved surface that touches the ramp.
quests.explanation: The ball and the can both have curved surfaces, so they can roll. The box has only flat faces and edges, so it slides instead.
quests.funFact: A can rolls straight on its side, but a ball can roll in any direction.

quests.instruction: Which group contains only objects shaped like cylinders?
quests.correctAnswer: A tin can, a battery, and a drinking straw
options: A tin can, a battery, and a drinking straw
A tin can, a ball, and a drinking straw
A battery, a dice, and a drinking straw
quests.hint: Check every object in a group. One wrong shape spoils the group.
quests.explanation: A tin can, a battery, and a drinking straw all have two circular ends and a curved side. A ball is a sphere and a dice is a cube.
quests.funFact: A tube is a cylinder with the inside hollowed out.

quests.instruction: Which group contains only objects shaped like spheres?
quests.correctAnswer: A marble, a globe, and a basketball
options: A marble, a globe, and a party hat
A marble, a dice, and a basketball
A marble, a globe, and a basketball
quests.hint: Check every object in a group. Each one must be round in every direction.
quests.explanation: A marble, a globe, and a basketball are all round in every direction. A party hat is a cone and a dice is a cube.
quests.funFact: Earth is a nearly perfect sphere, slightly wider at the equator than at the poles.

quests.instruction: A box of tissues, a cereal box, and a brick are all shaped like which solid?
quests.hint: Look at the faces: are they all squares, or are they rectangles?
quests.explanation: All three have six rectangular faces and are longer in some directions than in others, so they are cuboids.
quests.funFact: Bricks are usually cuboids because they stack with flat faces and leave no gaps.

quests.instruction: A ball, a marble, and a dice are on a table. Which is different from the other two?
quests.hint: Two of them are round in every direction.
quests.explanation: The ball and the marble are spheres. The dice is a cube with flat faces, so it is the odd one out.
quests.funFact: A ball and a dice are both solids, but only the ball has no flat faces.

quests.instruction: A battery, a candle, and a party hat are on a shelf. Which is shaped differently from the other two?
quests.hint: Two of them have the same width from top to bottom.
quests.explanation: The battery and the candle are cylinders, with the same width along their length. The party hat is a cone that narrows to a point.
quests.funFact: Party hats, ice cream cones, and traffic cones are all shaped like cones.

quests.instruction: A cube, a cuboid, and a cylinder are shown. Which is the odd one out?
quests.hint: Think about which of the three has a curved surface.
quests.explanation: The cube and the cuboid are made only of flat faces. The cylinder has a curved side, so it is the odd one out.
quests.funFact: Of these three solids, only the cylinder can roll on its side.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape has exactly one flat face?
quests.hint: Count the flat faces: a cube has the most, so start there.
quests.explanation: A cone has one flat round face at its base, and the rest of it is a curved surface up to a point. A cylinder has two flat faces and a cube has six.
quests.funFact: A cone has one flat face, one curved surface, and one pointed tip.

quests.instruction: A toy box has six flat square faces. What solid shape is it most like?
quests.hint: Think about what shape all six faces have to be.
quests.explanation: A solid with six square faces of the same size is a cube. A sphere has no flat faces, and a pyramid has triangular sides.
quests.funFact: A cube has twelve edges and eight corners.

quests.instruction: Which flat shape appears on the bottom of both a cylinder and a cone?
quests.hint: Think about what you would see if you looked at each one from underneath.
quests.explanation: Both a cylinder and a cone stand on a flat round face, so the shape on the bottom of each one is a circle.
quests.funFact: Both a cylinder and a cone have circle-shaped flat faces.
